task_completion.description: Create partition walls for the apartment set while leaving the 'fourth wall' open for cameras.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a U-shaped or multi-room wall configuration within the warehouse shell that has one side completely open to the rest of the floor space.

task_completion.description: Define and name at least three rooms (e.g., 'Apartment Set', 'Camera Floor', 'Backstage').
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for text labels or room area markers in the 2D plan view identifying at least three distinct zones by name.

task_completion.description: Apply distinct floor colors or textures to at least two of the defined rooms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 3D view or 2D plan, observe at least two rooms having different colors or patterns on the floor surface compared to the default warehouse floor.

task_completion.description: Furnish the apartment with 1 sofa, 1 table, 2 residential chairs, 2 appliances, and 2 decor items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify the specific furniture count inside the walled apartment area: a sofa, a table, two chairs, two appliances (e.g., fridge, stove), and two decorative objects (e.g., plants, pictures).

task_completion.description: Set up a production zone with 4 lights, 2 desks, and 4 office chairs/stools facing the open set.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a cluster of items in the 'Camera Floor' or open area containing at least 4 lamp/light icons, 2 desks, and 4 office-style seats oriented toward the apartment.

task_completion.description: Include at least two dimension lines indicating distance from camera positions to main set seating.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Locate at least two measurement/dimension line annotations in the 2D plan view connecting the production zone to the sofa/seating area.
Look for the 'Save' icon being clicked, a 'File > Save' menu interaction, or the window title bar losing an 'unsaved' asterisk/indicator.

integrity.description: Agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D drawing pane, and the 3D preview, rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The design is a result of manual placement, not a pre-loaded template.
integrity.visual_evidence: The progression of screenshots should show walls being drawn and furniture items being dragged individually from the catalog into the workspace.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Sweet Home 3D application interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Sweet Home 3D logo, menus (File, Edit, Furniture), and the specific four-pane layout (catalog, list, 2D, 3D) must be visible.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must work within the 'soundstage_starter.sh3d' file. Success is defined by the presence of new walls forming an apartment, specific furniture counts (1 sofa, 1 table, 2 residential chairs, 2 appliances, 2 decor in the set; 4 lights, 2 desks, 4 office chairs in the production zone), at least 3 named rooms, 2 different floor colors, and 2 dimension lines. The 'fourth wall' must remain open for camera sightlines.
